hypothesis: Public PerceptionControlResult construction may admit evidence-bearing or compute-attempt states without the immutable policy identity required by the active WP702 claim, even though evaluate_perception_head supplies policy_sha256 on its normal known-head path.
counterhypothesis: PerceptionControlResult.__post_init__ rejects OK, OUTPUT_BLOCKED and COMPUTE_ERROR states when policy_sha256 is absent, so no forged policy-unbound typed result can be constructed.

failed_cases: OK result without policy_sha256 did not raise PerceptionControlError
OUTPUT_BLOCKED result without policy_sha256 did not raise PerceptionControlError
COMPUTE_ERROR result without policy_sha256 did not raise PerceptionControlError
observed_result.material_finding: The counterhypothesis is falsified at repository-hosted review-CI scope: the public typed result contract currently admits these three policy-unbound states. This is a policy/provenance closure gap in the active WP702 candidate branch, not evidence of a perception runtime failure.

coordination.recommended_owner_action: Active WP702 mutation authority should evaluate the falsifier and, if contract intent is confirmed, require non-null exact policy_sha256 for OK, OUTPUT_BLOCKED and COMPUTE_ERROR before rerunning both canonical WP702 tests and this review falsifier.
